original.statement: The Go module path for Crossplane and Crossplane Runtime has changed from `github.com/crossplane/crossplane` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime` to include a `v2` suffix: `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2`; all import statements in code must be updated.

corrected.statement: Crossplane v2 changed its Go module paths to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2. Go code that imports these modules must update its go.mod module path and all import statements to the v2 paths.

decision.reason: [ev-d241daaf3863] says Crossplane's own Go module path now has a `/v2` suffix, and that anyone importing `crossplane` or `crossplane-runtime` must update go.mod and every import statement. The proposal uses the product-relationship family, but that family is for a dependency on a different product, not for Crossplane's own module identity. The text describes a required operator step (updating the module path and imports), so the right subject is the migration family with change type migration-required, not a product-relationship rename.
